purpose.en: Finite real acceptance obligations for review before implementation; rows are not test results.
purpose.zh: 编码前复核使用的有限真实验收义务；各行不是测试结果。

scope_note: Prioritize the first real S→O→D→Assembly/v4 loop. Every row is assigned to first_real_loop_required, inherited_helper_contract, or next_extension. Inherited helper review is not a fresh execution pass. E/copy/merge-v2 positives and richer boundary support are following finite milestones; the first loop must reject unsupported legacy/descendant claim downgrades now. Do not wait for every future positive or claim the whole family implemented.

FABC.en: A fresh bound local Registry with real bootstrap/task/principal/schema authority and exact Registration; publish a closed Module S with basic operation components A→B→C, declared C primary terminal, explicit caller-defined schemas/outcomes and no effects. Stable source element IDs come from actual publication. No fabricated ValidatedClosedRevision values. All executor bodies are inert/uninvoked; no Harness/RunOwner/provider/model/network/worker execution. O selection is exactly B; C and ingress are supplied by caller. Fixtures are created only after implementation approval.
FABC.zh: 下一阶段经授权后新建真实本地 Registry 与 task/principal/schema/Registration，发布真实 A→B→C 和 C terminal；不造 full-reader 返回值，不执行 executor/runtime/provider。B 选择、C 和 ingress 都明确给出。

FING.en: FABC plus independently and genuinely published closed input producer P. D intent pins exact prospective Assembly command/owner/member and P member/ref/exit. Actual Assembly/v4 contains P and D, connects P.result to extracted B ingress, selects D.C terminal and uses actual compiler final fragments. Also exercise explicitly public ingress with a one-member actual Assembly.
FING.zh: FABC 加真实独立发布的闭合输入 producer P。实际 v4 组合 P 与 D，连接 P.result→B ingress，以 D.C 完成；还覆盖单成员真实 Assembly 的显式 public ingress。

FRESOURCE.en: Fresh supported typed declaration/PNFragment fixtures via trusted deterministic HOST lowering and the actual compiler, carrying real lease/pool/slot/reset/feedback/effect relationships. Use existing petri_contracts and compiler-supported shapes; cite actual source compiled pointers. Unknown/custom opaque lowering is explicit unsupported coverage. Do not inspect or reuse paused 14C, original missing raw fixtures or runtime sources; no execution.
FRESOURCE.zh: 经可信确定性 HOST lowering 和实际 compiler 构建真实 typed declaration/PNFragment，覆盖 lease/pool/slot/reset/feedback/effect。不可用计数器或布尔旗标代替真实关系，不读取／复用暂停的 14C 或丢失 raw fixtures，不执行运行。

FDERIVED.en: FABC/FING plus real D; create new E/copy/merge-v2 only through the proposed explicitly selected producers and real full readers. E1/E2 have real declaration edits with common closed base D. Include rename-preserving IDs and a real conflicting atom requiring an explicit resolution.
FDERIVED.zh: 以真实 D 经拟议显式 producer 产生 E/copy/merge-v2；E1/E2 在共同闭合 D 上作真实声明变更，含保留 ID 的 rename 与必须显式解决的冲突。

FLEGACY.en: Fresh fixtures through accepted formal-v8 ordinary/graph/merge-v1/Assembly-v2/v3 producers. Reuse supported fixture construction patterns from existing test modules only after approval; do not claim the historical excluded raw fixtures were restored. Original 70 execution-evidence files remain historical, not a new run.
FLEGACY.zh: 通过已接受 v8 producer 新建 ordinary/graph/merge-v1/Assembly-v2/v3 fixture；仅在授权后复用已存测试构造模式；原 70 份证据仅为历史记录，不宣称丢失 raw fixtures 已恢复或重跑。

shared_acceptance_rules: Every success requiring persistence uses real immutable publication and a reopened full consumer; synthetic references/helper-only return objects cannot satisfy it.

Each negative must record the actual failing boundary. For semantic corruption, preserve canonical outer publication where needed so the intended deeper consumer is reached; a blob-hash failure does not prove semantic target validation.

Use one snapshot per full public read with private active paths; record enough exact refs and material bytes to reproduce the relevant read. No global visited-set rejection of valid repeated siblings.
No-write replay evidence includes before/after authoritative objects, resources, events and transaction counts, not just equal Python return values.
Capture ordinary generated-v1 and explicit Assembly entry results separately; never promote a bare generated read to composition/adaptation proof.

No test may create a runtime/provider/model/network/browser/worker/new-run/effect action, make a security or remote change, or inspect/retry 14C. Actual compilation and author Registry publication are the future offline acceptance boundary.
The matrix is finite: each row and listed finite variant is required in its accepted scope. No random fuzzing, arbitrary product cap, or timer determines completion.

Before claiming acceptance, map each accepted row/variant to the final test function, execution evidence and terminal outcome. Deferred rows remain explicitly pending; no static check is counted as a product pass.

title.en: Persist a genuinely nonterminal B selection
title.zh: 持久化真正非终结的 B 选择

cases.action: Publish S; explicitly select only stable B component ID with new_lineage; publish O; close and reopen the Registry; full-read O before any closure call.
cases.required_result: O persists with distinct logical ID, empty parents/selected changes, completion=null and exact ingress, egress and missing-completion obligations. S is unchanged.
cases.case_evidence: Exact S/O refs; stored canonical resources; full reader trace; actual source compiled inventory; O snapshot before D exists.

title.en: Require explicit lineage selection
title.zh: 谱系选择不得默认

cases.action: Submit the actual open publisher request with each invalid mode.
cases.required_result: Reject before O revision commit; no automatic policy or legacy fallback.
cases.case_evidence: Request, rejection phase, before/after committed revision rows.

title.en: Resolve stable selection in exact source
title.zh: 从精确来源解析稳定选择

cases.action: Use malformed/stale/non-component/duplicate selection IDs and a source revision with changed locators.
cases.required_result: Invalid selections fail; an exact renamed source using retained stable B identity selects that component without name-based guessing.
cases.case_evidence: Exact source maps, selected declarations and independent full read.

title.en: Keep open data outside closed entries
title.zh: 开放数据不得进入闭合入口

cases.action: Pass persisted O through full closed reader, closed author parent entry, merge input, Assembly member, and Module candidate preparation.
cases.required_result: Every closed-only entry rejects O; open descriptor and full open read remain usable.
cases.case_evidence: Per-entry actual call/rejection and unchanged O material.

title.en: Close B with caller-selected C
title.zh: 用调用者选择的 C 闭合 B

cases.action: Publish O; submit exact C context, declared C terminal/retained alternatives and public-entry ingress; invoke actual extractor/compiler; publish D; reopen and use ordinary full closed reader.
cases.required_result: Strong D root reconstructs B+C exactly, terminal is declared C, origin map covers all D elements, open input remains exact; proof is current result but target remains prospective.
cases.case_evidence: Actual ExtractPlan/result, Module/compiled inventories, HOST/schema refs, closure command and reopened full read; assert no execution facts.

title.en: An actual Assembly consumes the adaptation
title.zh: 真实 Assembly 消费适配证明

cases.action: Publish real closed P; close O to D with an intent naming exact P member/ref/exit and target D member; publish Assembly/v4 connecting P.result to D ingress and selecting D.C terminal; reopen full Assembly reader.
cases.required_result: Actual P→B→C final Module/fragment composition; target fields and carrier/terminal facts match; exact generated-v1 pair; returned proof records actual matched adaptation.
cases.case_evidence: Persisted v4 plan, closure/intent/material refs, final actual-fragment lowering map, generated pair and reopened full read; no helper-only success.

title.en: Never infer context or completion
title.zh: 不得推断补充上下文或完成规则

cases.action: Attempt closure using each incomplete or altered request against saved O.
cases.required_result: No D commit; identify exact missing/unsupported completion or context choice; O remains saved.
cases.case_evidence: Request and identified field/item; revision publication counts.
finite_variants: empty context with B terminal invented

title.en: Selection and context form the exact union
title.zh: 选择与上下文构成精确并集

cases.action: Supply context overlapping B, undeclared extra A, or altered component list/output plan inconsistent with the command.
cases.required_result: Reject inconsistency; neither supplement context nor trim caller selection; new command with a fully explicit valid supported selection may be separately prepared.
cases.case_evidence: Reconstructed component order/list, exact selection and context pins.

title.en: Strong proof covers every input and output
title.zh: 强证明覆盖每项输入和输出

cases.action: Starting from real published D, independently alter the designated material or build an otherwise canonical altered candidate through the new producer boundary.
cases.required_result: Full closed read or final publication fails at the affected proof check; compilation alone cannot accept it.
cases.case_evidence: Identify earliest failing layer; preserve canonical outer publication for semantic-mismatch variants so deeper checks actually run.

title.en: Actual bytes and authority remain strict
title.zh: 严格核验真实字节与权威

cases.action: Reopen a fresh Registry copy for each corruption; change one canonical publication or stored byte property.
cases.required_result: Reject missing/exact/authority/integrity mismatch without repair or fallback.
cases.case_evidence: Actual stored bytes/digests, exact prepared/publication evidence and read trace.

title.en: Source and owner cannot be substituted
title.zh: 不得替换来源或 owner

cases.action: Use real second local source/owner Registry and source-qualified refs with matching-looking logical IDs; also change producer or owner version.
cases.required_result: Exact source/owner/producer mismatch fails; no remote lookup or alias inference.
cases.case_evidence: Both source bindings, exact owner/principal versions, failing full-reader/publisher boundary.
finite_variants: same task ID wrong task version

title.en: Open persistence has its own replay result
title.zh: 开放持久化有独立幂等结果

cases.action: Publish O, reopen, replay identical command, then replay each changed request under the original command.
cases.required_result: Identical returns exact O with zero writes; changed content conflicts; no additional logical root.
cases.case_evidence: Resource/object/event/transaction counts before and after replay, same exact O refs.

title.en: Closure has exact no-write replay
title.zh: 闭合命令精确零写重放

cases.action: Publish D and replay after reopen; separately vary each command-bound field.
cases.required_result: Exact same result on identical request with zero writes; every changed field conflicts even if reconstructed Module bytes happen to match.
cases.case_evidence: Closure command bytes, refs and Registry counts.

title.en: Interrupted prefixes remain replayable
title.zh: 中断前缀可按原命令继续

cases.action: Interrupt publication at each explicit cut; restore only the exact missing original dependency and retry original command.
cases.required_result: Committed immutable prefix may survive; no result before final cut; original retry finishes once with original identities; changed retry conflicts.
cases.case_evidence: Per-cut committed rows/material refs; before/after recovery counts; final full read.

title.en: Branch histories reflect distinct roots
title.zh: Branch 历史反映独立 roots

cases.action: Create O Branch, attempt O→D advance with exact CAS expectations; attempt D Branch using O upstream; create independent D Branch.
cases.required_result: Both fabricated-history operations fail; new D Branch has fork base D and no upstream O; O Branch remains unchanged.
cases.case_evidence: Exact Branch commit results/current descriptors and direct-parent rejection.

title.en: No inferred resource grant
title.zh: 不得从结构闭合推断资源授权

cases.action: Read O, D and matched Assembly proof; inspect Registry for runtime/claim/adoption facts and returned capability fields.
cases.required_result: Only author/material/Assembly facts exist; no allocation, permission, lease grant, runtime binding, readiness or adoption claim is created.
cases.case_evidence: Actual before/after relevant fact categories; returned structured proof fields; zero executor/provider invocations.

title.en: Inventory uses actual lowered structure
title.zh: 清单检查真实 lowering 结构

cases.action: Use fresh trusted deterministic HOST lowerers with actual compiler-supported resource/control fragments crossing selected components; publish/read O.
cases.required_result: Every supported observed crossing is inventoried, or exact unsupported coverage is persisted; no absence inferred from missing named Module links.
cases.case_evidence: Actual PNFragment and compiled inventory pointers tied to inventory rows; no synthetic counter substituted.

title.en: Unresolved structural boundaries cannot close
title.zh: 结构边界未解决不能闭合

cases.action: Attempt closure of each real FRESOURCE O with boundary omitted, outer_owned-only, or runtime-pending relabeling.
cases.required_result: Saveable O remains; closure rejects unresolved/incompatible structure. No fake arbitration or transferred exclusive capability.
cases.case_evidence: Exact inventory item, unresolved reason and absence of D revision.

title.en: Dispositions exactly cover all obligations
title.zh: 每项义务必须恰有一次处置

cases.action: Alter disposition coverage or add C context whose new crossing is not accounted for.
cases.required_result: Reject missing/duplicate/unknown item and incomplete context inventory; no blanket success flag.
cases.case_evidence: Inventory IDs, recomputed union boundary, per-item result.

title.en: Unsupported semantics stay pending
title.zh: 不支持语义保持待定

cases.action: Supply a valid exact source requiring the listed adapter/semantic contract and ask this adapter to close it.
cases.required_result: Return specific unsupported_contract or unresolved_boundary; do not reinterpret, invent success, choose a context, or impose a permanent product exclusion.
cases.case_evidence: Exact source/contract and capability failure.

title.en: Actual target must match all intent fields
title.zh: 实际目标必须匹配全部意图字段

cases.action: Build real Assembly requests differing in exactly one identity field from D intent.
cases.required_result: Reject adapted path; no ordinary fallback, latest lookup, or intent rewrite.
cases.case_evidence: Actual Assembly request-derived target versus immutable intent, rejection before Assembly commit.

title.en: Actual ingress preserves caller policy
title.zh: 实际 ingress 保留调用者策略

cases.action: For a canonical target identity, change the actual connection/public exposure under each variant.
cases.required_result: Reject target/boundary mismatch even if ordinary composition can compile.
cases.case_evidence: Real composed carrier cut, exact member/ref/exit mapping, proof-stage trace.

title.en: Root completion is checked in composition
title.zh: 在组合中验证根完成

cases.action: Keep target identity but select different completion member/terminal or consume final C terminal carrier into another member.
cases.required_result: Reject claimed adaptation; actual root terminal and exposed carrier must agree with the explicit C contract.
cases.case_evidence: Full final Module terminal and actual compiled carrier/terminal checks.

title.en: Carrier aliases cannot fake valid wiring
title.zh: carrier 别名不能伪造合法连接

cases.action: Use real lowering with aliased entries/exits or two consumers/producers sharing a final carrier.
cases.required_result: Existing actual-context carrier uniqueness and terminal rules reject incompatible wiring; no name-only validation.
cases.case_evidence: Actual fragments, baseline removing only Assembly connections, failing source/target carrier.

title.en: Prospective intent may remain unconsumed
title.zh: 预期意图可保持未消费

cases.action: Publish/read D and never publish its planned Assembly.
cases.required_result: D proves exact closure only; intent remains prospective_unverified indefinitely; no fulfilled flag or membership record.
cases.case_evidence: Registry absence of Assembly and returned target_status after reopen.

title.en: Reuse O through two separately matched Assemblies
title.zh: 复用 O 并由两个独立 Assembly 精确消费

cases.action: Reject one D intent reused under another member/Assembly target. Reclose the same real O twice as D1 and D2 with distinct exact intents; publish two separate valid Assemblies, each selecting its own adapted member as root completion; reopen both full readers.
cases.required_result: Reused or wrong target fails. D1/D2 have distinct roots and exact matches in their separate Assemblies despite equal Module bytes. In one Assembly, two adapted members both requiring member_primary_terminal cannot both match its single root completion; keep that case negative/pending until an explicit alternative/contribution-completion contract. No arbitrary global member-count cap.
cases.case_evidence: Two real Assembly plans/refs, distinct intent and D refs, actual compiled/lowering origins and reopened proofs; wrong-target rejection. This does not claim a same-Assembly multi-adapted positive.

title.en: New target needs fresh adaptation
title.zh: 新目标需要新适配

cases.action: Reuse D under a different Assembly command or exact parent; then reclose O to D2 with the new intent and publish the supported successor.
cases.required_result: Reuse fails; explicit D2 root succeeds; old D intent unchanged; no new fabricated D2 history parent.
cases.case_evidence: Both Assembly target derivations, D/D2 IDs and full reads.

title.en: Nested adapted placement is an explicit gap
title.zh: 嵌套适配是明确能力缺口

cases.action: Supply D as a child/nested adapted occurrence to a legacy resolver or the new direct-member resolver.
cases.required_result: Reject exact unsupported relationship; no leaf-ID-only target match or plain fallback; existing accepted v2/v3 ordinary nesting remains available.
cases.case_evidence: Actual entry/ref type and rejected resolution path.

cases.fixture: FABC/FING now; FDERIVED only for future copy/merge-v2 variants

title.en: Legacy resolvers do not acquire new claims
title.zh: 旧 resolver 不暗中接受新主张

cases.action: Present real D to legacy Assembly/merge gates. Also prepare a canonical old-marker closed_author_command_v1 E parented by D through controlled low-level test publication, and invoke both the legacy ordinary producer and the ordinary full reader. Future explicit copy/merge-v2 probes await their next milestone.
cases.required_result: First loop: legacy producer AND full reader reject old-marker E with new proof-bearing D ancestry; legacy Assembly/merge reject D. No base-wrapper or plain_closed_v1 downgrade. Future new copy/merge-v2 results also remain ineligible to legacy resolvers when implemented.
cases.case_evidence: Per-resolver locked resolution classification and failure stage.

title.en: Generated v1 retains independent authority
title.zh: generated v1 保留独立权威

cases.action: Read actual Assembly-generated G via ordinary v1 entry; separately corrupt/remove Assembly-only proof and read G and Assembly again.
cases.required_result: G still proves only its valid independent v1 material if intact; explicit Assembly read fails missing/corrupt composition proof; G has no adaptation-consumed claim.
cases.case_evidence: Read traces show no mandatory G→Assembly traversal; typed result claims; both entry outcomes.

title.en: Generated pairing stays exact
title.zh: generated 配对保持精确

cases.action: Substitute an adapted or merge result with equal Module bytes, or alter one generated identity/material/compile field in a canonical Assembly candidate.
cases.required_result: Full Assembly rejects the substitute; exact ordinary result type and all paired fields remain required.
cases.case_evidence: Actual paired field comparison and exact type contract; no isinstance-only acceptance.

title.en: Proof traversal detects true cycles
title.zh: 证明遍历检测真实循环

cases.action: Use controlled fresh proof mutations to create cycles; separately reuse one completed ordinary sibling member twice.
cases.required_result: True active-path cycles reject; repeated siblings remain valid distinct occurrences; same-read-cut dependency evidence is retained.
cases.case_evidence: Active reference path and actual reader trace for each variant.
cases.integration_note: Reuse the reviewed active-path helper and existing cycle/repeated-sibling tests; add only new O/closure cross-reference integration coverage needed by first-loop implementation. This label does not waive cycle rejection.

title.en: Assembly final cut revalidates dependencies
title.zh: Assembly 最终切面重验依赖

cases.action: Invalidate one exact dependency after successful preparation but before final Assembly publication in a fresh controlled Registry.
cases.required_result: No Assembly commit; immutable prefixes can remain; restoring exact dependency permits same-command completion once.
cases.case_evidence: Prepare/final-read traces and authoritative Assembly object/event counts.

title.en: Assembly replay is exact and write-free
title.zh: Assembly 重放精确且零写

cases.action: Publish/reopen actual v4; retry identical request then change name/member/connection/completion/intent under same command.
cases.required_result: Identical returns original exact proof and zero writes; changed request conflicts even where generated bytes are unchanged.
cases.case_evidence: Request/plan envelope and Registry before/after counts.

title.en: Ordinary conversion is explicit
title.zh: 普通转换必须显式

cases.action: Attempt legacy ordinary edit after D without mode; then use new derived command with ordinary_new_definition to publish real E and reopen full reader.
cases.required_result: Legacy path rejects; explicit E succeeds with actual closed parent D, complete current Module and historical_only derivation; current adaptation is none.
cases.case_evidence: Exact derived command, total historical summary, recursive D read and E compilation.
cases.first_loop_boundary: Do not implement this positive family before the first loop. The first-loop rejection boundary is OR-29, including ordinary legacy full read of canonical old-marker E parented by D.

title.en: Historical proof survives ordinary successors
title.zh: 普通后继保留历史证明

cases.action: Publish E2 after E1 and then damage exact ancestral D proof in an isolated copy.
cases.required_result: Valid chain preserves historical summary without current claim; damaged ancestor fails full E2 read; base wrapper cannot erase proof classification.
cases.case_evidence: E1/E2 summaries, exact ancestor material reads and returned classification.
cases.first_loop_boundary: Do not implement this positive family before the first loop. The first-loop rejection boundary is OR-29, including ordinary legacy full read of canonical old-marker E parented by D.

title.en: A genuine E advances D Branch
title.zh: 真正的 E 可推进 D Branch

cases.action: Create D Branch, publish explicit derived E with direct parent D, advance with correct three expectations; retry stale/ABA-shaped expectations.
cases.required_result: Genuine advance succeeds; stale/changed expectations reject; no proof upgrade from Branch success.
cases.case_evidence: Branch versions/head/sequence, exact direct parent and closed result classification.
cases.first_loop_boundary: Do not implement this positive family before the first loop. The first-loop rejection boundary is OR-29, including ordinary legacy full read of canonical old-marker E parented by D.

title.en: Same-lineage merge has honest authority
title.zh: 同谱系 merge 保持真实权威

cases.action: Publish E1/E2 from D with distinct actual Module edits; use proposed merge-v2 analysis, explicit conflict decisions and ordinary-new-definition result; reopen full closed reader.
cases.required_result: Unique base D; exact ordered parents E1/E2; merged real declarations and HOST compile; provenance historical_only, no current target proof.
cases.case_evidence: Real analysis/resolution/command resources, normalized atom reconstruction, compiled result and recursive full reads.
cases.first_loop_boundary: Do not implement this positive family before the first loop. The first-loop rejection boundary is OR-29, including ordinary legacy full read of canonical old-marker E parented by D.

title.en: Provenance does not fabricate a merge base
title.zh: 来源不能伪造 merge base

cases.action: Analyze D versus S and D versus separately reclosed D2 under the new explicit merge contract; separately use legacy v1 with D/E.
cases.required_result: New analysis reports unrelated_histories; no result publisher success. Legacy v1 rejects ineligible new proof family; it is not silently broadened.
cases.case_evidence: Actual closed ancestry sets and result classification.
cases.first_loop_boundary: Do not implement this positive family before the first loop. The first-loop rejection boundary is OR-29, including ordinary legacy full read of canonical old-marker E parented by D.

title.en: Merge cannot refresh a target proof
title.zh: merge 不能刷新目标证明

cases.action: Present real M as adapted_result_current with ancestral D intent; then select explicit ordinary_new_definition in a later explicitly versioned resolver.
cases.required_result: Adapted claim fails; ordinary claim may compose valid current Module while recording historical-only origins, with no preserved-source requirement claim.
cases.case_evidence: Both actual later-version resolver resolution requests/outcomes and exact M summary.
cases.first_loop_boundary: Do not implement this positive family before the first loop. The first-loop rejection boundary is OR-29, including ordinary legacy full read of canonical old-marker E parented by D.

title.en: Copy creates new identity and no current target
title.zh: copy 产生新身份且无当前目标资格

cases.action: Copy D/E/M through explicit copy_root command and full read; attempt use as adapted D, then valid ordinary-new-definition member under a later explicitly versioned resolver.
cases.required_result: New logical/element IDs, parents empty, exact total copy origins; adapted use fails; explicit ordinary use succeeds when structurally valid.
cases.case_evidence: Copy source/material refs, ID disjointness, origin map, Assembly classifications.
cases.first_loop_boundary: Do not implement this positive family before the first loop. The first-loop rejection boundary is OR-29, including ordinary legacy full read of canonical old-marker E parented by D.

title.en: Missing authority choice never falls back
title.zh: 缺少权威选择不能 fallback

cases.action: Omit/alter derived or merge authority_mode; remove historical summary/marker from canonical proof-bearing request.
cases.required_result: Reject command/claim mismatch; never silently downgrade to accepted ordinary producer.
cases.case_evidence: Actual producer/full-reader entry and precise missing mode/material.
finite_variants: adapted failure retried as implicit ordinary
cases.first_loop_boundary: Do not implement this positive family before the first loop. The first-loop rejection boundary is OR-29, including ordinary legacy full read of canonical old-marker E parented by D.

title.en: Ordinary conversion changes no workflow requirement
title.zh: 普通转换不改变工作流要求

cases.action: Publish/read E/M/copy and inspect changed facts; request an adapted-required claim for each through the typed proof boundary.
cases.required_result: No workflow requirement update occurs; adapted-required claims reject; independent ordinary author/Assembly publication needs no new business decision.
cases.case_evidence: Author-only fact diff and claim_not_proved results, without running a workflow.
cases.first_loop_boundary: Do not implement this positive family before the first loop. The first-loop rejection boundary is OR-29, including ordinary legacy full read of canonical old-marker E parented by D.

title.en: Existing catalogs and recipe bytes remain exact
title.zh: 既有 catalog 与 recipe 字节保持精确

cases.action: Compare accepted builder inventories/schema/type/recipe data to exact formal-v8 baseline; combine new catalog with deliberate conflicting shared definitions.
cases.required_result: Accepted values unchanged; conflict rejected; new contracts require opt-in.
cases.case_evidence: Canonical inventories and schema/recipe byte hashes; actual catalog assembly errors.

title.en: Accepted ordinary paths remain valid
title.zh: 已接受普通路径保持有效

cases.action: Generate fresh legitimate ordinary/graph/merge-v1 and nested-v2/v3 fixtures using the recovered supported producers, then reopen their existing full readers.
cases.required_result: Same accepted contracts, ordinary edits after merge, exact generated pairing and repeated instance origins remain valid. No claim that old excluded raw fixtures were restored or rerun.
cases.case_evidence: Fresh fixture provenance, real refs/read traces and relevant existing regression entry results after implementation.
cases.integration_note: Reuse accepted legacy tests and fresh supported fixture patterns; rerun only boundaries affected by new dispatch/rejection guards. The original 70 evidence files are historical, not a rerun.

title.en: No resource or business policy is silently changed
title.zh: 不得静默修改资源或业务策略

cases.action: Change budget bindings, required schemas, cardinality/outcomes or completion while pretending to use the same reconstruction recipe.
cases.required_result: Exact reconstruction rejects; structural success cannot authorize altered source obligations or arbitrary new limits.
cases.case_evidence: Source/result declaration diffs and exact rejected contract field.

title.en: Known open failures remain inspectable
title.zh: 已知开放失败仍可检查

cases.action: Persist O with known unsupported coverage/needs_adapter; inspect descriptor and full open result after closure rejection.
cases.required_result: O, exact provenance and every unresolved reason survive; no cleanup, fake terminal or replacement source.
cases.case_evidence: Stored resources and full open result after failed closure.

title.en: Display names do not substitute identity
title.zh: 显示名不能替代身份

cases.action: Create distinct members with same display name; vary display names under a fresh legitimate target while preserving/re-attesting exact IDs as required.
cases.required_result: Member resolution remains ID/ref based; same-name members do not merge; target re-attestation rule still applies to new commands.
cases.case_evidence: Exact member/intent map and generated origin locations.

open_business_boundary.description: Replacing an existing real workflow requirement is outside this author/Assembly slice. Ordinary conversion grants no such authority and triggers no new business question here.

first_real_loop_required.en: Implement and verify the real independent O persistence, caller-selected B+C closure, actual exact-target Assembly consumption, essential rejection/replay and legacy descendant fail-closed boundaries.
first_real_loop_required.zh: 首片实现并验证独立 O、显式 B+C 闭合、实际精确目标 Assembly 消费、必需拒绝／重放及 legacy 后继拒绝门。

inherited_helper_contract.en: Reuse the already reviewed existing helper contract; validate affected integration boundaries and relevant existing regressions. This is neither a new test pass nor a demand to rerun all historical evidence.
inherited_helper_contract.zh: 继承已审既有 helper 合同，检查受影响集成边界及相关回归；既不记为新通过，也不要求重跑全部历史证据。

next_extension.en: A following finite capability milestone. Keep unsupported gates explicit now; do not block the first real loop on these positive implementations or count them as delivered.
next_extension.zh: 紧接的有限能力里程碑；当前明确拒绝尚不支持路径，不用这些正向实现阻塞首闭环，也不记为已交付。

first_loop_sequence: Add only the opt-in open/provenance/inventory/closure contracts and full readers needed by FABC; persist/reopen real nonterminal O before closure.
Implement exact source-component completion using the existing extractor/compiler/full-material pipeline; publish/reopen strong D with caller-selected C and ingress.
Integrate direct adapted Assembly/v4 and a real FING P→B→C proof; preserve strict generated-v1 pairing and independent ordinary reader authority.
Enforce legacy Assembly/merge rejection of D and both ordinary publisher/full-reader rejection of old-marker E parented by D; no silent claim erasure.
Run the first-loop acceptance boundaries and only affected inherited helper regressions; report deferred E/copy/merge-v2 and richer completion/resource adapters as pending.
